title: Can Small Language Models Reliably Resist Jailbreak Attacks? A Comprehensive Evaluation
reasoning: The paper evaluates the ethical alignment and safety safeguards of models by benchmarking their resistance to jailbreak attacks. It utilizes a dataset covering 14 risk categories derived from usage policies, including 'Hate Speech', 'Illegal Activity', and 'Pornography', which directly assesses the model's adherence to predefined ethical and moral boundaries.
